title: Blob Royale protocol v3 hill component
description: The scoring circle carried by the hill entity, in wu. The hill entity owns no physics_body and no controllable. Same shape as the zone component and a different meaning: inside a hill is where a player scores, inside a zone is where a player is safe, and a client draws the two apart by kind. This is the hill's only center/radius publication; random-roaming hills additionally publish current velocity through hill_motion.
